topic: Asking for a Different Size in Fitting

script.title: ONE SIZE UP
script.title_quote: Do these come in a size up?
script.story_hook: Trying on jeans goes wrong until an associate helps.
script.intro_zh: 牛仔褲試穿卡關，還好店員伸出援手。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today we ask for help inside a fitting room. Listen for size words.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天我們在試衣間裡請店員幫忙。留意各種尺寸的說法。
script.outro: Good fits take a little asking. Try, adjust, smile. See you next time!
script.outro_zh: 合適的尺寸要靠開口問。試穿、調整、笑一笑。下次見！
script.practice_intro_en: Play it again and copy each line with feeling.
script.practice_intro_zh: 再撥一次，帶著感情把每個句子讀出來。
script.char_a_description: a petite woman in her late twenties with a short black bob and gold hoop earrings, a striped cotton shirt under denim overalls, curly lashes, white canvas sneakers
script.char_b_description: a tall slender man in his forties with sandy blond hair swept back, a light blue polo under a beige store apron, round friendly face, simple wristwatch

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, do these come in a size up?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz mi duː ðiːz kʌm ɪn ə saɪz ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，這件尺碼能不能再大一點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which item do you have there?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈɪtəm du ju hæv ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 您手上是哪件商品？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These slim jeans, but the waist is tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiːz slɪm dʒiːnz bət ðə weɪst ɪz taɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這條窄版牛仔褲，腰頭太緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What size are you wearing now?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt saɪz ɑɹ ju ˈwɛɹiɪŋ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 您現在穿幾號？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A twenty-eight, but maybe thirty-two fits.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪ ˈtwɛnti ˈeɪt bət ˈmeɪbi ˈθɜɹdi tu fɪts/
dialogue.zh: 是二八號，不過三二說不定剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Makes sense. Let me check the stock room.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪks sɛns lɛt mi tʃɛk ðə stɑk rum/
dialogue.zh: 有道理，我去後倉看一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you! I really like this wash.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθæŋk ju aɪ ˈɹɪli laɪk ðɪs wɑʃ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！我很喜歡這個洗色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's popular. The thirty-two... um...
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈpɑpjələr ðə ˈθɜɹdi tu ʌm/
dialogue.zh: 這很受歡迎。三二號……嗯……

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it still available?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt stɪl əˈveɪləbəl/
dialogue.zh: 還有貨嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry — you're wearing our last pair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑɹi jʊɹ ˈwɛɹiŋ ˈaʊɚ lɑst pɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，您身上這條就是最後一條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh! So there's no size up left?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ soʊ ðɛɹz noʊ saɪz ʌp lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 啊！所以沒有更大條的了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not in this color, I'm afraid.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ɪn ðɪs ˈkʌlɚ aɪm əˈfɹeɪd/
dialogue.zh: 這個顏色的，賣完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, what other colors do you have?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm wʌt ˈʌðɚ ˈkʌlɚz du ju hæv/
dialogue.zh: 其他顏色還有什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dark blue and black, both in thirty-two.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɑɹk blu ənd blæk boʊθ ɪn ˈθɜɹdi tu/
dialogue.zh: 深藍跟黑色，三二都有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The black sounds perfect, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə blæk saʊndz ˈpɜɹfɪkt ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 黑色的聽起來剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll grab one for the fitting room.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ɡɹæb wʌn fɚ ðə ˈfɪtɪŋ rum/
dialogue.zh: 我拿一條給您進試衣間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're too kind. How many can I try?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ tu kaɪnd haʊ ˈmɛni kæn aɪ traɪ/
dialogue.zh: 您真好。我最多能試幾件？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three items, and we check the tags.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɹi ˈɪtəmz ənd wi tʃɛk ðə tæɡz/
dialogue.zh: 三件為限，店員會檢查吊牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No problem. One quick question, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm wʌn kwɪk ˈkwɛstʃən ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，不過我有一個問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, go ahead.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊɹ goʊ əˈhɛd/
dialogue.zh: 您請說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do these shrink after washing?
dialogue.phonetic: /duː ðiːz ʃɹɪŋk ˈæftɚ ˈwɑʃɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 洗過後會縮嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: These are pre-washed, so the fit stays.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiːz ɑɹ pri wɑʃt soʊ ðə fɪt steɪz/
dialogue.zh: 這些是預洗的，尺寸不變。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, that worries me every time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ðæt ˈwɜɹiz mi ˈɛvɹi taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我以前都很擔心這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's your black pair, size thirty-two.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹz jʊɹ blæk pɛɹ saɪz ˈθɜɹdi tu/
dialogue.zh: 您的黑色來了，三二號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect — back in two minutes!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt bæk ɪn tu ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，兩分鐘就好！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, no line right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jʊɹ taɪm noʊ laɪn raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來，現在沒有人排隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay... hmm, they fit, but they're long.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ həm ðeɪ fɪt bət ðɪɹ lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好了……嗯，尺寸剛好但太長了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How long are we talking?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ ɑɹ wi ˈtɔkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 大概長多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe three inches past my shoes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi θɹi ˈɪntʃəz pæst maɪ ʃuːz/
dialogue.zh: 大約超過鞋子三吋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do hemming here, or cuff them stylish.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du hɛmɪŋ hɪɹ ɔɹ kʌf ðɛm ˈstaɪlɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 這裡可以改褲邊，也可以捲著穿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hemming — how much and how long?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɛmɪŋ haʊ mʌtʃ ənd haʊ lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 修改要多少錢，多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight dollars, ready by Friday this week.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ˈdɑləz ˈɹɛdi baɪ ˈfɹɑɪˌdeɪ ðɪs wiːk/
dialogue.zh: 八塊錢，本週五可以取。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday's the wedding! That's actually perfect.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɹɑɪˌdeɪz ðə ˈwɛdɪŋ ðæts ˈæktʃuəli ˈpɜɹfɪkt/
dialogue.zh: 週五就是婚禮！時間剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice — what do you do for the groom?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs wʌt du ju du fɚ ðə ɡrum/
dialogue.zh: 真好，您是新郎的什麼人？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His cousin! I want to look sharp, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪz ˈkʌzən aɪ wɑnt tə lʊk ʃɑɹp ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我是他表姊！想穿得帥氣一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then black jeans with a shirt? Classic.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn blæk dʒiːnz wɪθ ə ʃɜɹt ˈklæsɪk/
dialogue.zh: 那黑牛仔褲配襯衫？經典。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly what my mom told me last week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli wʌt maɪ mɑm toʊld mi læst wiːk/
dialogue.zh: 上週我媽也是這麼說的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mothers usually know best.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌðɚz ˈjuːʒəwəli noʊ bɛst/
dialogue.zh: 媽媽們通常最有道理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, should I buy them with the hemming?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ʃʊd aɪ baɪ ðɛm wɪð ðə ˈhɛmɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那就連修改一起買吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'd say yes — the sale saves five dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪd seɪ jɛz ðə seɪl seɪvz faɪv ˈdɑləz/
dialogue.zh: 我說是的，特價可以省五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll take them. Oh — it declined?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪl teɪk ðɛm oʊ ɪt dɪˈklained/
dialogue.zh: 好，我買了。咦，刷卡失敗？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happens sometimes. Try a different card?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpənz ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz traɪ ə ˈdɪfɹənt kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 偶爾會這樣，換一張卡試試？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me check my bag... um, here's another.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk maɪ bæɡ ʌm hɪɹz əˈnʌðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我翻包看看……呃，這張試試。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one worked. Receipt: email or paper?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn wɜɹkt rɪˈsip ˈiːmeɪl ɔɹ ˈpeɪpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 這張通了。收據要電子檔還是紙本？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Email's great, if that's an option.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈiːmeɪlz ɡɹeɪt ɪf ðæts ən ˈɑpʃən/
dialogue.zh: 寄email最好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. Now, the hem job by Friday, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn naʊ ðə hɛm dʒɑːb baɪ ˈfɹɑɪˌdeɪ raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好了。修改週五取，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! Will you text me when they're ready?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wɪl ju tɛkst mi wɛn ðɪɹ ˈɹɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 對！弄好了會傳訊給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, and we validate parking here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊɹ ənd wi ˈvæləˌdeɪt ˈpɑɹkɪŋ hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，對了，這裡停車可以折抵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, I hate those meter fees.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs aɪ heɪt ðoʊz ˈmiːtɚ fiz/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我最討付費表停車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hours free with any purchase.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈaʊɚz fri wɪð ˈɛni ˈpɜɹˌtʃəs/
dialogue.zh: 消費滿額免費停兩小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last question — the tight pair?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn læst ˈkwɛstʃən ðə taɪt pɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 最後一個問題，那條太緊的怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Return it today, tags still on, easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈtɜɹn ɪt təˈdeɪ tæɡz stɪl ɑn ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 今天吊牌別拆，拿回來就能退。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But these are the last ones, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /bət ðiːz ɑɹ ðə lɑst wʌnz raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 但那條是最後一條了吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll put them back out tonight, no fear.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl pʊt ðɛm bæk aʊt təˈnaɪt noʊ fɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，我今晚就重新掛上架。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. What a Saturday!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt wʌt ˈsætɚˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太完美了，週六就是要這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best part is getting a good fit.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛst pɑɹt ɪz ˈɡɛtɪŋ ə ɡʊd fɪt/
dialogue.zh: 找到合適的尺寸最開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You made this easy. Thank you!
dialogue.phonetic: /ju meɪd ðɪs ˈizi θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 您讓我好輕鬆，謝謝！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday at two — see you then, bye!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɹɑɪˌdeɪ æt tu si ju ðɛn baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 週五兩點見，再見！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bye! I'll bring the tight pair too.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ aɪl brɪŋ ðə taɪt pɛɹ tu/
dialogue.zh: 再見！我也會帶那條太緊的來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Have a great weekend, and nice wedding!
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ə ɡɹeɪt ˈwiːkˌɛnd ənd naɪs ˈwɛdɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 週末愉快，婚禮順利！

script.youtube_title_en: "Do These Come in a Size Up?" — Asking for a Different Size in Fitting
script.youtube_description:
牛仔褲太緊，怎麼請店員帮忙換尺寸？這段「試衣間」美式英語聽力陪你走一遍！🎧

一位顧客在試衣間對著腰頭發愁，店員幫忙找貨、推薦顏色、安排修改褲邊，中間還夾著刷卡失敗的小插曲。你會學到一整套試穿、換號、退換的自然說法。

這一集重現服飾店試衣間旁的完整對話：報尺寸、查後倉、約修改時間、折抵停車費，每句都不超過十個詞，A2 初級聽得懂、用得上。

你會聽到：
🔸 開場求助：Do these come in a size up?
🔸 庫存沒貨：Sorry — you're wearing our last pair.
🔸 修改服務：We do hemming here, or cuff them stylish.
🔸 付款插曲：Happens sometimes. Try a different card?

🎧 後半段是逐句聽力加跟讀練習，同一句先聽母語語調，再開口複製一次，把六十分鐘的句子聽到會說。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用，尺寸、修改、退貨的說法全都收進耳朵。

喜歡的話按讚、訂閱並打開小鈴鐺，每週一段生活情境聽力。留言告訴我們：你試穿時遇過最好笑的尺寸問題是什麼？

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_en: Jeans too tight? Learn exactly what to say in a fitting room with this A2 American English listening practice. A shopper asks an associate for one size up, only to discover she is wearing the store's last pair. Together they check colors, plan a hem job before a wedding, handle a declined card, and sort out free parking validation. Every sentence is short, natural, and full of real store phrases like size up, stock room, hemming, and try a different card. The second half of the video is a sentence-by-sentence listen and repeat session, so the words stick without memorizing. Perfect for ESL learners preparing for shopping trips abroad. Like and subscribe for a new daily-life dialogue every week, and tell us: what is the funniest sizing mix-up you have ever had?

這一集帶大家走進服飾店試衣間，看店員如何幫顧客找尺寸、改褲長，還順便搞定停車折抵。
你會聽到：

🔸 修改服務｜「We do hemming here, or cuff them stylish.」比較兩種褲邊做法。
🔸 付款對策｜「Try a different card?」刷卡失敗時不尷尬的應付方式。

後半段是逐句聽力加跟讀練習 🎧 先聽母語語調，再開口複製，把六十分鐘的試穿英語聽到會說。
